recognize_zh: 低倍下整張抹片布滿大小不一、形狀不規則的紅血球團塊，均勻分布於全視野而非只在厚區，這種瀰漫性凝集是冷凝集素的典型低倍表現。
features: Diffuse red cell agglutination: numerous irregular clumps of red cells distributed evenly across the smear at low power
Clumps vary in size and have irregular, branching outlines rather than linear stacks
Intervening single red cells present between clumps
Scattered leukocytes with no obvious increase at this magnification; individual cell detail limited by low power
describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows diffuse red cell agglutination, with innumerable irregular clumps of red cells scattered uniformly throughout the monolayer. The clumps are irregular and branching rather than linear rouleaux. Scattered leukocytes are present; detailed cytologic assessment is not possible at this magnification. Findings are consistent with cold agglutinin-mediated red cell agglutination, as seen in cold agglutinin disease.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux appear as linear coin stacks with an associated bluish proteinaceous background, whereas this smear shows irregular three-dimensional clumps.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with an IgG-positive DAT and generally lacks diffuse macroscopic agglutination.
PCH is caused by the biphasic IgG Donath-Landsteiner antibody and usually shows erythrophagocytosis rather than prominent agglutination.
